description: React component definitions for a command palette UI, including dialog, input, list, and item components, utilizing Radix UI primitives and custom styling.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: A styled wrapper around the cmdk Command primitive with forwarded ref.

classes.name: CommandDialog
classes.description: A dialog component that contains the command palette.

classes.name: CommandInput
classes.description: Input component with search icon for command palette filtering.

classes.name: CommandList
classes.description: Scrollable list container for command items.

classes.name: CommandEmpty
classes.description: Component shown when no command items are available.

classes.name: CommandGroup
classes.description: Grouped section within the command list.

classes.name: CommandItem
classes.description: Individual command item with styling and state handling.

classes.name: CommandShortcut
classes.description: Display for keyboard shortcuts associated with command items.

methods.name: React.forwardRef
methods.description: Creates React components with forwarded refs for command palette parts.

methods.description: Utility function for conditional className concatenation.
